note: TRUE boundaries of the gnucobol-rs front-end: COBOL surfaces that GnuCOBOL 3.2 itself cannot run, does not implement, or only produces non-deterministic/host-specific output for -- so there is NO fixed oracle for gnucobol-rs to be byte-identical to. These are recorded for a SEPARATE kobold-side layer that may implement them with its own conformance model (NOT the GnuCOBOL 3.2 byte oracle). DATA ONLY: no gnucobol/libcob GPL source. Supersedes frontend-boundary-intrinsics-build-plan.json (most of those have since been built natively in gnucobol-rs; front-end intrinsics are now 91/110).
source: gnucobol-rs COBOL-PARITY.md -- front-end intrinsics 91/110 wired byte-identical; these are the genuine boundaries.

boundaries.name: BOOLEAN-OF-INTEGER
boundaries.why_true_boundary: cobc rejects it at compile in GnuCOBOL 3.2 ("FUNCTION 'X' is not implemented") -- libcob never implements it, so a program using it does not compile and there is no oracle output to match

boundaries.name: MODULE-PATH
boundaries.why_true_boundary: cobc returns the COMPILED BINARY path (the -o output); an interpreter produces no binary, so there is no analog to reproduce

boundaries.name: SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT
boundaries.why_true_boundary: reads the LIVE wall clock and ignores COB_CURRENT_DATE -- there is no fixed oracle value, so it cannot be byte-matched even under a pinned clock

boundaries.name: NATIONAL
boundaries.why_true_boundary: USAGE NATIONAL (UTF-16) is declared UNFINISHED in GnuCOBOL 3.2 (cobc emits -Wunfinished 'handling of USAGE NATIONAL is unfinished; implementation is likely to be changed', and the explicit USAGE NATIONAL form does not compile) -- pinning to an admittedly-unstable implementation is not a 1:1 target. This is a USAGE form, not an intrinsic FUNCTION

boundaries.name: RANDOM
boundaries.why_true_boundary: RANDOM's value is GMP's INTERNAL Mersenne-Twister stream (libcob delegates to gmp_randinit_mt + gmp_randseed_ui; the GMP-specific seeding is verified NOT to be the textbook MT init_by_array). gnucobol-rs ports libcob's ALGORITHMS, not GMP's internals, and does not link libgmp -- so the exact bit-stream is a declared substrate boundary (like the host x87 80-bit long double).
